summary: Iteration 5 testing of graffiti spray-tag + animated sprite WS features. CRITICAL bug found & hot-fixed: server.py ClientConn.__init__ was missing anim_id / anim_stance params while line 590 passed anim_id positionally AND line 275 read c.anim_id/c.anim_stance — every WebSocket join was crashing with `TypeError: ClientConn.__init__() takes 6 positional arguments but 7 were given`, breaking the entire app (chat, spray, anim). After fix all 8 new iter5 pytest tests pass + backend/frontend flows verified. Backend: 8/8 iter5 tests PASS (rest GET/DELETE tags, tag_spray WS broadcast+persist+no `_id`, snapshot includes tags, tag_clear broadcast+delete, stance broadcast+snapshot, anim broadcast+snapshot, MAX_TAGS_PER_ROOM cap <=80). Frontend (desktop 1920x1080): spray-window opens from start-menu, spray-toggle flips label '◉ SPRAYING' + bg rgb(179,255,0), floating-spray-can appears beside iso-avatar, tag-layer computed mixBlendMode='screen', placed-tag wrapper bg rgba(0,0,0,0) (NO BLACK RECT — key user req MET), preset & custom tags placed, spray-clear removes all tags. Full regression: 40/43 pytest PASS (2 stale tests hardcode 5 rooms but backend now serves 11 — not a bug; 1 flaky stance test times out on full run but passes in isolation).

rca of the issue: Root cause of the blocking WS crash: when the feature batch added anim_id + anim_stance to the realtime-state model, the ws_endpoint was updated to accept/pass `anim_id` (server.py L584, L590) and room_user_list / snapshot payloads were updated to read `c.anim_id` / `c.anim_stance` (L275, L633), but ClientConn.__init__ was NOT updated to accept or initialise those fields. Every WebSocket `/api/ws/{room_id}` handshake therefore failed with `TypeError: ClientConn.__init__() takes 6 positional arguments but 7 were given`, taking down chat / spray / anim entirely. Mitigation applied by testing agent: extended ClientConn.__init__ signature to `(self, ws, user_id, nickname, avatar_url, sprite_id, anim_id=None, anim_stance='idle')` and initialised both fields. Reproduction before fix: `wscat -c "wss://strange-worlds-chat.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws/hello?user_id=X&nickname=Y"` → server logs traceback and closes connection. After fix: handshake succeeds, snapshot + broadcasts work, iter5 tests all pass.
